packageRules.description: engines is the oldest Node.js and Bun Circuit runs on, which the documentation promises; it is raised by hand, never to the latest.

@types/node follows the Node.js major CI publishes with (release.yml), not the latest: newer types describe APIs Circuit's users may not have, and v26 already rejects Duplex.from with a readable and writable pair.
Node.js in CI and in the release workflow moves only to an even major, the ones that become LTS.

customManagers.description: The newest Node.js LTS that CI checks on (check.yml), marked with a renovate comment. The oldest one beside it has no comment, so it never moves.
